content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue connecting my [product_name] with Node-RED on a Raspberry Pi. Currently, there are two separate web servers hosted on the [product_name] ([version_no]) for different processes. My goal is to link the [product_name] ([version_no]) with IoT applications through Node-RED. I've installed the 'node red - S7' library on my Raspberry Pi.

Hello [user_name], You do not configure the connection in that section. The setup should be done elsewhere. This process is well documented in the manual, and there are also instructional videos available online, especially regarding integration with Node-RED. Regards [user_name]
